name: Theo Prinz von Hirschreich
original_name: テオ・プリンツ・フォン・ハーシュライヒ
source:
An international student and the country of Harshreich's fourth prince. He seems to excel at both swords and academics. While he takes a hostile and intimidating attitude towards Argo and other students from Frontail, he is kind to his fellow Harshreich students.

Likes: Training, studying, meditation.
Dislikes: Irresponsible people.

[Based on [url=http://kaiju09.com/knights_college/english/]official character profile[/url].]

[spoiler]His E.P. ability is teleportation.[/spoiler]
